sources.officialProductEvidence: The official Salomon page confirms sizes 157/165/173/181/189 cm, 106 mm waist, Freeride Profile, Rocker-Camber-Rocker, 16.5 m radius (page's displayed reference), Full Poplar Woodcore, Ti Binding Reinforcement, Basalt Superlight Fibers, Fiberglass, Full Sandwich Sidewalls and Cork Damplifier.
sources.sizeTableEvidence: The 2026/27 Salomon catalogue table lists all five lengths for article L47774500+, including per-length tip/waist/tail, radius, midsole position, and a weight column explicitly labeled WEIGHT (/ski). It reports 1800 g per ski at 173 cm. The catalogue is the season-specific primary source for the full table; the same article reference is visible on Salomon's official product page.

mappingNotes: The seed's turnRadius uses the 173 cm reference (18.5 m); all five sizes' sidecut, radius and single-ski weight are retained.

The official product page's 3000 g net-weight field does not identify its reference length or per-ski/per-pair basis and is not mapped. The separately cited 2026/27 catalogue explicitly labels weight per ski; its 173 cm value (1800 g) is used.
